units.zh: 少帝諱義符，小字車兵，武帝長子也。
units.en: Emperor Shao, taboo name Yifu, childhood name Chebing, was Emperor Wu's eldest son.
units.literal: Emperor Shao's taboo name was Yifu; his childhood name was Chebing. He was the eldest son of Emperor Wu.

units.zh: 母曰張夫人。
units.en: His mother was Lady Zhang.
units.literal: His mother was Lady Zhang.

units.zh: 晉義熙二年，生於京口。
units.en: He was born at Jingkou in the second year of Yixi of Jin.
units.literal: In the second year of Yixi of Jin, he was born at Jingkou.

units.zh: 武帝晚無男，及帝生，甚悅。
units.en: Emperor Wu had long been without a son; when the emperor was born, he was greatly pleased.
units.literal: Emperor Wu had long been without a son; when the emperor was born, he was greatly pleased.

units.zh: 年十歲，拜豫章公世子。
units.en: At age ten, he was invested as heir of the Duke of Yuzhang.
units.literal: At age ten, he was invested as heir of the Duke of Yuzhang.

units.zh: 帝有旅力，善騎射，解音律。
units.en: The emperor was strong and vigorous, excelled at horseback archery, and understood musical theory.
units.literal: The emperor had strength and vigor, excelled at horseback archery, and understood musical theory.

units.zh: 宋臺建，拜宋世子。
units.en: When the Song regime was established, he was invested as Song heir.
units.literal: When the Song regime was established, he was invested as Song heir.

units.zh: 元熙元年，進為宋太子。
units.en: In the first year of Yuanxi, he was advanced to Song crown prince.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxi, he was advanced to Song crown prince.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，立為皇太子。
units.en: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, he was installed as crown prince.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, he was installed as crown prince.

units.zh: 永初三年五月癸亥，武帝崩，是日，太子即皇帝位。
units.en: On the guihai day of the fifth month of the third year of Yongchu, Emperor Wu died; that same day the crown prince ascended the throne.
units.literal: On the guihai day of the fifth month of the third year of Yongchu, Emperor Wu died; on that same day the crown prince assumed the imperial throne.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 尊皇太后曰太皇太后。
units.en: The empress dowager was elevated to grand empress dowager.
units.literal: The empress dowager was honored as grand empress dowager.

units.zh: 六月壬申，以尚書僕射傅亮為中書監，司空徐羨之、領軍將軍謝晦及亮輔政。
units.en: On the renshen day of the sixth month, Fu Liang, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; the Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, the General Who Leads the Army Xie Hui, and Liang were made regents.
units.literal: On the renshen day of the sixth month, Fu Liang, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; the Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, the General Who Leads the Army Xie Hui, and Liang were appointed to assist in government.

units.zh: 戊子，太尉長沙王道憐薨。
units.en: On the wuzi day, the Grand Commandant, Prince of Changsha Dao Lian, died.
units.literal: On the wuzi day, the Grand Commandant, the Prince of Changsha, Dao Lian, died.

units.zh: 秋九月丁未，有司奏武皇帝配南郊，武敬皇后配北郊。
units.en: In autumn, on the dingwei day of the ninth month, the relevant offices submitted that Emperor Wu should receive joint sacrifice at the southern suburban altar and Empress Wu Jing at the northern suburban altar.
units.literal: In autumn, on the dingwei day of the ninth month, the relevant offices memorialized that Emperor Wu should be paired at the southern suburb altar and Empress Wu Jing at the northern suburb altar.

units.zh: 冬十一月戊午，有星孛于營室。
units.en: In winter, on the wuwu day of the eleventh month, a broom star appeared in the Encampment lodge.
units.literal: In winter, on the wuwu day of the eleventh month, a comet appeared in the Encampment mansion.

units.zh: 十二月庚戌，魏軍克滑臺。
units.en: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month, the Wei army took Huatai.
units.literal: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month, the Wei army captured Huatai.

units.zh: 明年春正月己亥朔，大赦，改元為景平元年。
units.en: On the new moon of the first month of spring of the following year, on the day jihai, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Jingping, year one.
units.literal: On the new moon of the first month of spring of the following year, the day jihai, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Jingping, year one.

units.zh: 文武進位二等。
units.en: Civil and military officials were advanced two ranks in status.
units.literal: Civil and military officials were promoted two ranks.

units.zh: 辛丑，祀南郊。
units.en: On the xinchou day, the southern suburban sacrifice was performed.
units.literal: On the xinchou day, sacrifice was offered at the southern suburb.

units.zh: [3]虜將達奚卬破金墉，進圍虎牢。
units.en: [3] The enemy general Daxi Ang took Jinyong and pressed on to besiege Hulao.
units.literal: [3] The barbarian general Daxi Ang captured Jinyong and advanced to besiege Hulao.

units.zh: [4]毛德祖擊虜敗之，虜退而復合。
units.en: [4] Mao Dezu attacked the enemy and routed them; the enemy withdrew and then rallied again.
units.literal: [4] Mao Dezu struck the barbarians and defeated them; the barbarians withdrew and then regrouped.

units.zh: 拓跋木末又遣安平公涉歸寇青州。
units.en: Tuoba Mumo again sent the Prince of Anping, Shegui, to invade Qingzhou.
units.literal: Tuoba Mumo again sent the Prince of Anping, Shegui, to raid Qingzhou.

units.zh: 癸卯，河南郡失守。
units.en: On the guimao day, Henan Commandery fell.
units.literal: On the guimao day, Henan Commandery was lost.

units.zh: 乙卯，有星孛于東壁。
units.en: On the yimao day, a broom star appeared in the Eastern Wall lodge.
units.literal: On the yimao day, a comet appeared in the Eastern Wall mansion.

units.zh: 二月丁丑，太皇太后崩。
units.en: On the dingchou day of the second month, the grand empress dowager died.
units.literal: On the dingchou day of the second month, the grand empress dowager died.

units.zh: 沮渠蒙遜、吐谷渾阿犲並遣使朝貢。
units.en: Juqu Mengxun and Tuguhun A'ai both sent envoys to court with tribute.
units.literal: Juqu Mengxun and Tuguhun A'ai both sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 庚辰，爵蒙遜為驃騎大將軍，封河西王。
units.en: On the gengchen day, [6] Mengxun was created General of Agile Cavalry [7] and enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.
units.literal: On the gengchen day, [6] Mengxun was ennobled as General of Agile Cavalry, [7] and enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.

units.zh: 以阿犲為安西將軍、沙州刺史，封澆河公。
units.en: A'ai was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Shazhou, and created Duke of Jiaohe.
units.literal: A'ai was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Shazhou, and enfeoffed as Duke of Jiaohe.

units.zh: 辛未，富陽人孫法光反，[8]寇山陰，會稽太守褚淡之遣山陰令陸劭討敗之。
units.en: On the xinwei day, Sun Faguang of Fuyang rose in revolt, [8] raided Shanyin, and the Governor of Kuaiji Chu Danzhi sent the Magistrate of Shanyin Lu Shao to defeat him.
units.literal: On the xinwei day, Sun Faguang of Fuyang rebelled, [8] raided Shanyin, and the Governor of Kuaiji Chu Danzhi sent the Magistrate of Shanyin Lu Shao to attack and defeat him.

units.en: [9] Editorial note nine stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
units.literal: [9] Editorial note nine stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

units.zh: 三月壬寅，孝懿皇后祔葬于興寧陵。
units.en: On the renyin day of the third month, Empress Xiaoyi was enshrined and buried at Xingning Mausoleum.
units.literal: On the renyin day of the third month, Empress Xiaoyi was enshrined and buried at Xingning Mausoleum.

units.zh: 是月，高麗國遣使朝貢。
units.en: That month, Goguryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
units.literal: That month, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 甲子，豫州刺史劉粹遣軍襲許昌，殺虜潁川太守庾龍。
units.en: On the jiazi day, Liu Cui, Inspector of Yuzhou, sent troops to raid Xuchang and killed the enemy Administrator of Yingchuan, Yu Long.
units.literal: On the jiazi day, Liu Cui, Inspector of Yuzhou, sent troops to raid Xuchang and killed the barbarian Administrator of Yingchuan, Yu Long.

units.zh: 乙丑，虜騎寇高平。
units.en: On the yichou day, enemy horsemen raided Gaoping.
units.literal: On the yichou day, barbarian horsemen raided Gaoping.

units.zh: 初虜自河北之敗，請修和親；
units.en: Earlier, after their defeat north of the Yellow River, the enemy had sought a marriage alliance;
units.literal: Earlier, after their defeat north of the Yellow River, the barbarians had requested a marriage alliance;

units.zh: 及聞高祖崩，因復侵擾，河、洛之地騷然矣。
units.en: when they learned that Emperor Gaozu had died, they resumed their incursions, and the Yellow and Luo region was thrown into turmoil.
units.literal: when they heard that Emperor Gaozu had died, they again launched raids, and the lands along the Yellow and Luo rivers were thrown into turmoil.

units.zh: 夏四月，檀道濟北征，次臨朐，焚虜攻具。
units.en: In summer, the fourth month, Tan Daoji marched north on campaign, halted at Linqu, and burned the enemy siege equipment.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Tan Daoji marched north on campaign, halted at Linqu, and burned the barbarians' siege equipment.

units.zh: 乙未，魏軍克虎牢，執司州刺史毛德祖以歸。
units.en: On the yiwei day, the Wei army took Hulao and carried off the Inspector of Sizhou, Mao Dezu.
units.literal: On the yiwei day, the Wei army captured Hulao and took the Inspector of Sizhou, Mao Dezu, back with them.

units.zh: 秋七月癸酉，尊所生張夫人為皇太后。
units.en: In autumn, on the guiyou day of the seventh month, his birth mother, Lady Zhang, was honored as empress dowager.
units.literal: In autumn, on the guiyou day of the seventh month, the birth mother, Lady Zhang, was honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 丁丑，以旱，詔赦五歲刑以下罪人。
units.en: On the dingchou day, because of drought, an edict pardoned offenders sentenced to five years or less.
units.literal: On the dingchou day, because of drought, an edict pardoned offenders sentenced to five years or less.

units.en: [11] Editorial note eleven stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
units.literal: [11] Editorial note eleven stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

units.zh: 冬十月己未，有星孛于氐，指尾，貫攝提，向大角，仲月在危，季月掃天倉而後滅。
units.en: In winter, on the jiwei day of the tenth month, a broom star appeared in the Root lodge, pointing toward the Tail, piercing Sheti, and heading toward the Great Horn; in the middle month it stood in Rooftop, in the last month it swept the Celestial Granary, and then it vanished.
units.literal: In winter, on the jiwei day of the tenth month, a comet appeared in the Root mansion, pointing toward the Tail, piercing Sheti, and heading toward the Great Horn; in the middle month it was in Rooftop, in the last month it swept the Celestial Granary, and then it vanished.

units.zh: 是歲，魏主拓跋嗣薨，子燾立。
units.en: That year, the Wei ruler Tuoba Si died and his son Tao succeeded him.
units.literal: That year, the Wei ruler Tuoba Si died and his son Tao succeeded.

units.zh: 十二月丙寅，[12]省寧州之江陽、犍為、安上三郡，合為宋昌郡。
units.en: On the bingyin day of the twelfth month, [12] the three commanderies of Jiangyang, Qianwei, and Anshang in Ningzhou were abolished and combined into Songchang Commandery.
units.literal: On the bingyin day of the twelfth month, [12] the three commanderies of Jiangyang, Qianwei, and Anshang in Ningzhou were abolished and combined into Songchang Commandery.

units.zh: 二年春二月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In spring of the second year, on the new moon of the second month, the day guisi, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In spring of the second year, on the new moon of the second month, the day guisi, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: [13]廢南豫州刺史廬陵王義真為庶人，徙新安郡。
units.en: [13] Prince of Luling Yizhen, Inspector of South Yuzhou, was deposed to commoner status and exiled to Xin'an Commandery.
units.literal: [13] The Prince of Luling, Yizhen, Inspector of South Yuzhou, was deposed as a commoner and moved to Xin'an Commandery.

units.zh: 乙未，以皇弟義恭為冠軍將軍，南豫州刺史。
units.en: On the yiwei day, the emperor's younger brother Yigong was appointed General Who Establishes Champions and Inspector of South Yuzhou.
units.literal: On the yiwei day, the emperor's younger brother Yigong was made General Who Establishes Champions and Inspector of South Yuzhou.

units.zh: 乙巳，大風，天有五色雲，占者以為有兵。
units.en: On the yisi day, a great wind blew; [14] five-colored clouds appeared in the sky, and diviners interpreted this as a portent of war.
units.literal: On the yisi day, a great wind blew; [14] five-colored clouds appeared in the sky, and diviners took this as a sign of war.

units.zh: 高麗國遣使貢獻。
units.en: Goguryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
units.literal: Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 執政使使者誅義真于新安。
units.en: The regents sent an envoy to execute Yizhen at Xin'an.
units.literal: The regents sent an envoy to execute Yizhen at Xin'an.

units.zh: 夏五月，江州刺史王弘、南兗州刺史檀道濟入朝。
units.en: In summer, the fifth month, Wang Hong, Inspector of Jiangzhou, and Tan Daoji, Inspector of South Yanzhou, came to court.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Wang Hong, Inspector of Jiangzhou, and Tan Daoji, Inspector of South Yanzhou, came to court.

units.zh: [15]帝居處所為多過失。
units.en: [15] In his conduct the emperor committed many faults.
units.literal: [15] In his conduct the emperor committed many faults.

units.zh: 乙酉，皇太后令曰：
units.en: On the yiyou day, the empress dowager issued an order, saying:
units.literal: On the yiyou day, the empress dowager issued an order, saying:

units.zh: 王室不造，天禍未悔，先帝創業弗永，棄世登遐。
units.en: The royal house has suffered misfortune; Heaven's wrath has not yet lifted; the late emperor's founding work was cut short when he died and passed beyond.
units.literal: The royal house has met with misfortune, Heaven's calamity has not yet relented, the late emperor's founding work did not last long, and he departed the world and ascended afar.

units.zh: 義符長嗣，屬當天位，不謂窮凶極悖，一至於此。
units.en: Yifu, as the eldest son, was meant to inherit the throne under Heaven; none could have foreseen that his vicious depravity would go so far.
units.literal: Yifu, as the eldest son and heir, was entrusted with the position under Heaven, yet who would have thought his utter villainy and extreme depravity would reach this point.

units.zh: 大行在殯，宇內哀惶，幸災肆於悖詞，喜容表於在慼。
units.en: While the late emperor still lay in state and the realm mourned, he delighted in others' misfortune and spoke rebelliously, wearing a cheerful countenance even amid mourning.
units.literal: While the late emperor lay in coffin, the realm mourned in grief, yet he took others' disaster as his pleasure and poured forth rebellious words, and showed joy upon his face even in the period of mourning.

units.zh: 至乃徵召樂府，鳩集伶官，優倡管絃，靡不備奏，珍羞甘膳，有加平日。
units.en: He even summoned the Music Bureau, gathered performers, and had singers, musicians, and string players perform without exception; delicacies and fine foods exceeded those of ordinary days.
units.literal: He even summoned the Music Bureau, gathered actors, and had singers, musicians, and string players all perform without exception; rare delicacies and fine foods exceeded those of ordinary days.

units.zh: 採擇媵御，產子就宮，靦然無怍，醜聲四達。
units.en: He selected concubines, and when they bore children he brought them into the palace without the least shame; scandal spread in every direction.
units.literal: He selected concubines, and when they bore children he brought them into the palace with perfect composure and no shame; foul reports spread in every direction.

units.zh: 及懿后崩背，重加天罰，親與左右執紼歌呼，推排梓宮，抃掌笑謔，殿省備聞。
units.en: When Empress Yi died, Heaven again punished him: he personally joined his attendants in grasping the mourning cords and singing aloud, pushed the inner coffin about, and clapped his hands in laughter and jest—the palace offices all heard of it.
units.literal: When Empress Yi died, Heaven added a further punishment: he personally joined his attendants in grasping the mourning cords and singing aloud, pushed the inner coffin about, clapped his hands and laughed and jested—the palace offices all heard of it.

units.zh: 加復日夜媟狎，羣小慢戲，興造千計，費用萬端，帑藏空虛，人力殫盡。
units.en: Moreover, day and night he indulged in lewd sport; his petty followers treated him with disrespect; he launched a thousand projects and spent ten thousand sums; the treasury was emptied and manpower exhausted.
units.literal: Moreover, day and night he indulged in lewd sport; his petty followers treated him with disrespect; he launched a thousand projects and spent ten thousand sums; the treasury was emptied and manpower exhausted.

units.zh: 刑罰苛虐，幽囚日增。
units.en: Punishments were harsh and cruel, and those imprisoned increased daily.
units.literal: Punishments were harsh and cruel, and those imprisoned increased daily.

units.zh: 居帝王之位，好皁隸之役，處萬乘之尊，悅廝養之事。
units.en: Though he occupied the throne, he delighted in the tasks of menial servants; though he possessed imperial dignity, he took pleasure in groom and stable work.
units.literal: Though he occupied the position of an emperor, he delighted in the tasks of black-clad servants; though he possessed the honor of the ten-thousand-chariot ruler, he took pleasure in groom and stable work.

units.zh: 親執鞭撲，毆擊無辜，以為笑樂。
units.en: He personally wielded the whip and flail, beat the innocent, and made this his amusement.
units.literal: He personally wielded the whip and flail, beat the innocent, and made this his amusement.

units.zh: 穿池築觀，朝成暮毀，徵發工匠，疲極兆民。
units.en: He dug ponds and built towers, completing them in the morning and destroying them in the evening; he conscripted craftsmen until the people were exhausted to the utmost.
units.literal: He dug ponds and built towers, completing them in the morning and destroying them in the evening; he conscripted craftsmen until the people were exhausted to the utmost.

units.zh: 遠近歎嗟，人神怨怒，社稷將墜，豈可復嗣守洪業，君臨萬邦。
units.en: Near and far sighed in lament; men and spirits were angered; the altars of soil and grain were about to fall—how could he again inherit and guard the great enterprise and rule the myriad states.
units.literal: Near and far sighed in lament; men and spirits were angered; the altars of soil and grain were about to fall—how could he again inherit and guard the great enterprise and rule the myriad states.

units.zh: 今廢為營陽王，一依漢昌邑、晉海西故事。
units.en: He is now deposed as Prince of Yingyang, following entirely the precedents of the Han Prince of Changyi and the Jin Emperor Haixi.
units.literal: He is now deposed as Prince of Yingyang, following entirely the precedents of the Han Prince of Changyi and the Jin Emperor Haixi.

units.zh: 鎮〔西將軍宜都王，仁明孝弟，著自幼辰。
units.en: The Prince of Yidu, General Who Guards the West, is benevolent, bright, filial, and fraternal, renowned from his earliest years.
units.literal: General Who Guards the West, the Prince of Yidu, is benevolent, bright, filial, and fraternal, renowned from his earliest years.

units.zh: 德業沖粹，識心明允。
units.en: His virtue and conduct are pure, and his mind and judgment are clear and fair.
units.literal: His virtue and conduct are pure, and his mind and judgment are clear and fair.

units.zh: 宜纂洪統，光臨億兆。
units.en: He should inherit the great succession and preside over the hundred million.
units.literal: He should inherit the great succession and preside over the hundred million.

units.zh: 主者詳依典故，以時奉迎。
units.en: The responsible officials should examine the precedents in detail and welcome him at the proper time.
units.literal: The responsible officials should examine the precedents in detail and welcome him at the proper time.

units.zh: 未亡人嬰此百罹，雖存若隕。
units.en: This surviving widow bears a hundred calamities; though alive, it is as if she had perished.
units.literal: This surviving widow bears a hundred calamities; though alive, it is as if she had perished.

units.zh: 永悼情事，撫心摧塞。
units.en: Forever grieving over these affairs, she presses her heart and is overwhelmed with anguish.
units.literal: Forever grieving over these affairs, she presses her heart and is overwhelmed with anguish.

units.en: 〕[16] Editorial note sixteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
units.literal: 〕[16] Editorial note sixteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

units.zh: 始徐羨之、傅亮將廢帝，諷王弘、檀道濟求赴國訃。
units.en: At first Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang were about to depose the emperor; they hinted to Wang Hong and Tan Daoji that they should come for the state mourning.
units.literal: At first Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang were about to depose the emperor; they hinted to Wang Hong and Tan Daoji that they should come for the state mourning.

units.zh: 弘等來朝。
units.en: Hong and the others came to court.
units.literal: Hong and the others came to court.

units.zh: 使中書舍人邢安泰、潘盛為內應。
units.en: They made the Attendant of the Masters of Writing Xing Antai and Pan Sheng their inside contacts.
units.literal: They made the Attendant of the Masters of Writing Xing Antai and Pan Sheng their inside contacts.

units.zh: 是旦，道濟、謝晦領兵居前，羨之等隨後，因東掖門開，入自雲龍門。
units.en: That morning, Tan Daoji and Xie Hui led troops in front while Xu Xianzhi and the others followed; because the East Side Gate was open, they entered through the Cloud Dragon Gate.
units.literal: That morning, Tan Daoji and Xie Hui led troops in front while Xu Xianzhi and the others followed; because the East Side Gate was open, they entered through the Cloud Dragon Gate.

units.zh: 盛等先戒宿衞，莫有禦者。
units.en: Sheng and the others had first warned the night guards, and none resisted.
units.literal: Sheng and the others had first warned the night guards, and none resisted.

units.zh: 時帝於華林園為列肆，親自酤賣。
units.en: At the time the emperor was in the Hualin Garden setting up a row of shops and personally selling wine.
units.literal: At the time the emperor was in the Hualin Garden setting up a row of shops and personally selling wine.

units.zh: 又開瀆聚土，以象破岡埭，與左右引船唱呼，以為歡樂。
units.en: He also opened a canal and piled earth to imitate the Pogang dam, and with his attendants pulled boats while shouting and calling—taking this as his pleasure.
units.literal: He also opened a canal and piled earth to imitate the Pogang dam, and with his attendants pulled boats while shouting and calling—taking this as his pleasure.

units.zh: 夕游天淵池，即龍舟而寢。
units.en: In the evening he toured the Tianyuan Pool and slept on the dragon boat.
units.literal: In the evening he toured the Tianyuan Pool and slept on the dragon boat.

units.zh: 其朝未興，兵士進，殺二侍者於帝側，傷帝指。
units.en: The court had not yet risen when soldiers entered, killed two attendants at the emperor's side, and wounded his finger.
units.literal: The court had not yet risen when soldiers entered, killed two attendants at the emperor's side, and wounded his finger.

units.zh: 夫出東閤，就收璽紱，羣臣拜辭，送於東宮，遂幽於吳郡。
units.en: He was taken out through the East Gate Pavilion, the seals and cords were taken from him, the officials bowed in farewell, he was sent to the Eastern Palace, and then confined in Wu Commandery.
units.literal: He was taken out through the East Gate Pavilion, the seals and cords were taken from him, the officials bowed in farewell, he was sent to the Eastern Palace, and then confined in Wu Commandery.

units.zh: 是日，赦死罪以下。
units.en: That day, those sentenced to death and below were pardoned.
units.literal: That day, those sentenced to death and below were pardoned.

units.zh: 太后令奉還璽紱。
units.en: The empress dowager ordered that the seals and cords be returned.
units.literal: The empress dowager ordered that the seals and cords be returned.

units.zh: 檀道濟入守朝堂。
units.en: Tan Daoji entered to guard the court hall.
units.literal: Tan Daoji entered to guard the court hall.

units.zh: 六月癸丑，徐羨之等使中書舍人邢安泰弒帝於金昌亭。
units.en: On the guichou day of the sixth month, Xu Xianzhi and the others had the Attendant of the Masters of Writing Xing Antai assassinate the emperor at Jinchang Pavilion.
units.literal: On the guichou day of the sixth month, Xu Xianzhi and the others had the Attendant of the Masters of Writing Xing Antai assassinate the emperor at Jinchang Pavilion.

units.zh: 帝有勇力，不即受制，突走出昌門，追以門關踣之，致殞。
units.en: The emperor was strong and courageous and did not submit at once; he burst out through Chang Gate, and pursuers struck him down with the gate bar, killing him.
units.literal: The emperor had strength and courage and did not submit at once; he burst out through Chang Gate, and pursuers struck him down with the gate bar, causing his death.

units.zh: 時年十九。
units.en: He was nineteen years old.
units.literal: He was nineteen years old.

units.en: [17] Editorial note seventeen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
units.literal: [17] Editorial note seventeen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

units.zh: 〈上闕〉
units.en: 〈The beginning of the passage is missing in the received text.〉
units.literal: 〈Upper portion missing〉

units.zh: 則創業之君，自天所啟；
units.en: then the founding ruler is one whom Heaven itself has opened the way for;
units.literal: then the founding ruler is one whom Heaven itself has opened the way for;

units.zh: 守文之主，其難乎哉！
units.en: for a ruler who merely keeps the inheritance, how hard it is!
units.literal: for a ruler who merely keeps the inheritance, how hard it is!

units.en: [18] Editorial note eighteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
units.literal: [18] Editorial note eighteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

units.zh: 紀所書皆誤。」
units.en: What the annal records is all wrong."
units.literal: What the annal records is all wrong."

units.zh: 尚書僕射徐羨之加鎮軍將軍，右衞將軍謝晦為中領軍，宋國領軍檀道濟為護軍將軍，中領軍劉義欣為青州刺史。
units.en: Secretariat Director Xu Xianzhi was additionally appointed General Who Stabilizes the Army; Right Guards General Xie Hui was made Central Army Commander; Song Domain Commander-in-Chief Tan Daoji was made Protector General; Central Army Commander Liu Yixin was made Governor of Qing Province.
units.literal: Secretariat Director Xu Xianzhi was additionally made General Who Stabilizes the Army; Right Guards General Xie Hui was made Central Army Commander; Song Domain Commander-in-Chief Tan Daoji was made Protector General; Central Army Commander Liu Yixin was made Governor of Qing Province.

units.zh: 以揚州刺史廬陵王義真為司徒，以尚書僕射、鎮軍將軍徐羨之為尚書令、揚州刺史。
units.en: The Prince of Luling, Yizhen, Governor of Yang Province, was made Minister over the Masses; Secretariat Director and General Who Stabilizes the Army Xu Xianzhi was made Director of the Secretariat and Governor of Yang Province.
units.literal: The Prince of Luling, Yizhen, was made Governor of Yang Province; Secretariat Director and General Who Stabilizes the Army Xu Xianzhi was made Secretariat Director and Governor of Yang Province.

units.zh: 癸丑，以尚書令、揚州刺史徐羨之為司空、錄尚書事，刺史如故。
units.en: On the day guichou, Secretariat Director and Governor of Yang Province Xu Xianzhi was made Minister of Works and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing, with his governorship unchanged.
units.literal: On the day guichou, Secretariat Director and Governor of Yang Province Xu Xianzhi was made Minister of Works and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing, with his governorship unchanged.

units.zh: 太尉長沙王道憐、司空徐羨之、尚書僕射傅亮、領軍將軍謝晦、護軍將軍檀道濟並入侍醫藥。
units.en: Grand Marshal Prince of Changsha Dao Lin, Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, Secretariat Director Fu Liang, Commander-in-Chief Xie Hui, and Protector General Tan Daoji all entered to attend him with medicine.
units.literal: Grand Marshal Prince of Changsha Dao Lin, Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, Secretariat Director Fu Liang, Commander-in-Chief Xie Hui, and Protector General Tan Daoji all entered to attend medicine.

units.zh: 徐羨之、傅亮當無異圖。
units.en: Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang should have no divergent designs.
units.literal: Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang should have no divergent designs.

units.zh: 時徐羨之住西州，嘗幸羨之，便步出西掖門，羽儀絡驛追隨，巳出西明門矣。
units.en: At the time Xu Xianzhi lived in West Province; once when he visited Xianzhi, he simply walked out the Western Side Gate on foot; the guard of honor pursued in relays and had already passed the Western Bright Gate before catching up.
units.literal: At the time Xu Xianzhi lived in West Province; once when he visited Xianzhi, he simply walked out the Western Side Gate; the guard of honor pursued in continuous relays and had already passed the Western Bright Gate.

units.zh: 又為手詔曰：「朝廷不須復有別府，宰相帶揚州，可置甲士千人。
units.en: He also made a hand edict: "The court need not again have a separate headquarters; the chief minister should hold Yang Province and may have one thousand armored soldiers.
units.literal: He also made a hand edict: "The court need not again have a separate headquarters; the chief minister should hold Yang Province and may have one thousand armored soldiers.

units.zh: 時劉裕誅桓玄，迎復安帝，玄衛將軍、新安王桓謙，臨原王桓怡，雍州刺史桓蔚，左衛將軍桓謐，中書令桓胤，將軍何澹之等奔於興。
units.en: After Liu Yu killed Huan Xuan and restored Emperor An, Huan Qian, Huan Yi, Huan Wei, Huan Mi, Huan Yin, He Danzhi, and others fled to Yao Xing.
units.literal: At the time Liu Yu had executed Huan Xuan, welcomed and restored Emperor An; Xuan's Guard General and Prince of Xin'an Huan Qian, Prince of Linyuan Huan Yi, Inspector of Yongzhou Huan Wei, General of the Left Guard Huan Mi, Director of the Secretariat Huan Yin, General He Danzhi, and others fled to Xing.

units.zh: 劉裕遣大參軍衡凱之詣姚顯，請通和，顯遣吉默報之，自是聘使不絕。
units.en: Liu Yu sent his senior staff officer Heng Kaizhi to Yao Xian to request peace; Yao Xian sent Ji Mo in reply, and from then on embassies were unceasing.
units.literal: Liu Yu sent senior staff officer Heng Kaizhi to Yao Xian begging open peace; Xian sent Ji Mo to answer him; from this envoys on friendly missions were unceasing.

units.zh: 群臣咸諫以為不可，興曰：「天下之善一也，劉裕拔萃起微，匡輔晉室，吾何惜數郡而不成其美乎！」
units.en: Ministers objected; Yao Xing said, "The good under heaven is one; Liu Yu, outstanding from humble beginnings, aids and supports the Jin house—why should I begrudge several commanderies and not complete his beauty!"
units.literal: The host of ministers all remonstrated that it could not be done; Xing said: "The good under heaven is one; Liu Yu, outstanding from humble beginnings, aids and supports the Jin house—why should I begrudge several commanderies and not complete his beauty!"

units.zh: 帝崩，昌邑王即位，廢，大將軍光、車騎將軍張安世與大臣議所立。
units.en: The emperor died. The king of Changyi was enthroned and then deposed. Grand General Huo Guang and Cavalry General Zhang Anshi deliberated with the great ministers on whom to enthrone.
units.literal: The emperor died; the King of Changyi ascended the throne and was deposed; Grand General Guang and Cavalry General Zhang Anshi deliberated with the great ministers on whom to enthrone.

units.zh: 玄與晉將毛德祖戰于柏穀，以眾寡而敗，被瘡十餘，據地大呼，玄司馬騫鑒冒刃抱玄而泣，玄曰：「吾瘡已重，君宜速去。」
units.en: At Baigu, Zhao Xuan fought the Jin general Mao Dezu and was defeated by superior numbers. He received more than ten wounds and cried out from the ground. His major, Qian Jian, braved the blades to hold him in his arms and wept. Xuan said, “My wounds are grave. You must leave at once.”
units.literal: Xuan fought Jin general Mao Dezu at Baigu; because few against many he was defeated, received more than ten wounds, clutched the ground and shouted; Xuan's Major Qian Jian braved blades, embraced Xuan and wept; Xuan said, "My wounds are already heavy—you ought quickly to depart."

units.zh: 庚午，以司空道憐為太尉，封長沙王。
units.en: On the day gengwu, the Minister of Works Dao Lin was appointed Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Changsha.
units.literal: On the day gengwu, the Minister of Works Dao Lin was made Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Changsha.

units.zh: 太尉持節監護，葬以晉禮。
units.en: The Grand Commandant held imperial credentials to oversee the funeral, and burial followed Jin rites.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant held imperial credentials to oversee the funeral, and burial followed Jin rites.

units.zh: 宋大明用江夏王義恭，以後無人。
units.en: Song's Prince Yigong of Jiangxia held it in the Daming era; after that, no one.
units.literal: In Song's Daming era Prince Yigong of Jiangxia held it; afterward no one.

units.zh: 太宰。
units.en: Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 撫軍將軍、江州刺史王弘進號衞將軍、開府儀同三司，太子詹事傅亮為尚書僕射，中領軍謝晦為領軍將軍。
units.en: General Who Comforts the Army and Governor of Jiang Province Wang Hong was advanced to General of the Guards and Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes; Household Mentor of the Heir Fu Liang was made Secretariat Director; Central Army Commander Xie Hui was made Commander-in-Chief.
units.literal: General Who Comforts the Army and Governor of Jiang Province Wang Hong was advanced to General of the Guards and Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes; Household Mentor of the Heir Fu Liang was made Secretariat Director; Central Army Commander Xie Hui was made Commander-in-Chief.

units.zh: 謝晦數從征伐，頗識機變，若有同異，必此人也。
units.en: Xie Hui has followed campaigns many times and knows well how opportunity shifts; if there is divergence, it will surely be this man.
units.literal: Xie Hui has followed campaigns many times and knows well how opportunity shifts; if there is divergence, it will surely be this man.

units.zh: 謝晦諫，即時遣出。
units.en: Xie Hui remonstrated, and he immediately sent her out.
units.literal: Xie Hui remonstrated, and he immediately sent her out.

units.zh: 南康縣公華容縣公可爲侯，萍鄉縣侯可爲伯，減戶有差，以繼劉穆之、王弘、何無忌後。」
units.en: The county dukes of Nankang and Huarong are made marquises; the marquis of Pingxiang is made an earl; household quotas are cut by rank, to carry on the houses of Liu Muzhi, Wang Hong, and He Wuji."
units.literal: The County Duke of Nankang and the County Duke of Huarong may become marquises; the Marquis of Pingxiang may become an earl; household quotas are reduced by grade, to continue the lines of Liu Muzhi, Wang Hong, and He Wuji."

units.zh: 璝率眾三萬追擊義真，王師敗績，義真單馬而遁。
units.en: Gui pursued Yizhen with thirty thousand; the Jin army was routed and Yizhen escaped alone.
units.literal: Gui led thirty thousand to pursue Yizhen; the royal army was defeated and Yizhen fled on a single horse.

units.zh: 買德獲晉甯朔將軍傅弘之、輔國將軍蒯恩、義真司馬毛脩之於青泥，積人頭以為京觀。
units.en: Maide captured the Jin General of Pacifying the North Fu Hongzhi, the General Who Supports the State Kuai En, and Yizhen's Marshal Mao Xiuzhi at Qingni and piled heads into a victory mound.
units.literal: Maide captured the Jin General of Pacifying the North Fu Hongzhi, the General Who Supports the State Kuai En, and Yizhen's Marshal Mao Xiuzhi at Qingni and piled heads into a mound.

units.zh: 於是為壇於灞上，僭即皇帝位，赦其境內，改元為昌武。
units.en: He made an altar at Bashang, took the throne, amnestied the realm, and proclaimed the Changwu era.
units.literal: Thereupon he made an altar at Bashang, usurped the emperor's position, amnestied within the borders, and changed the era name to Changwu.

units.zh: 尋而晉太尉劉裕總大軍伐泓，次於彭城，遣冠軍將軍檀道濟、龍驤將軍王鎮惡入自淮、肥，攻漆丘、項城，將軍沈林子自汴入河，攻倉垣。
units.en: Soon afterward Jin’s grand commandant Liu Yu led a great army against Yao Hong and halted at Pengcheng. He sent Champion General Tan Daoji and Dragon-Soaring General Wang Zhen’e in by the Huai and Fei rivers to attack Qiqiu and Xiangcheng. General Shen Linzi entered the Yellow River from the Bian and attacked Cangyuan.
units.literal: Before long Liu Yu, grand commandant of Jin, led a great army against Hong and halted at Pengcheng. He sent Champion General Tan Daoji and Dragon-Soaring General Wang Zhen'e in by the Huai and Fei rivers to attack Qiqiu and Xiangcheng. General Shen Linzi went from the Bian into the Yellow River to attack Cangyuan.

units.zh: 泓將王苟生以漆丘降鎮惡，徐州刺史姚掌以項城降道濟，王師遂入潁口，所至多降服。
units.en: Hong’s general Wang Gousheng surrendered Qiqiu to Wang Zhen’e, and Yao Zhang, inspector of Xuzhou, surrendered Xiangcheng to Tan Daoji. The Jin army then entered Yingkou, and many places submitted as it advanced.
units.literal: Hong’s general Wang Gousheng surrendered Qiqiu to Wang Zhen’e, and Yao Zhang, inspector of Xuzhou, surrendered Xiangcheng to Tan Daoji. The Jin army then entered Yingkou, and many places submitted as it advanced.

units.zh: 惟新蔡太守董遵固守不降，道濟攻破之，縛遵而致諸軍門。
units.en: Only Dong Zun, governor of Xincai, held firm and refused to surrender. Tan Daoji stormed the place, had Zun bound and brought him to the gate of the camp.
units.literal: Only Xin'cai Grand Administrator Dong Zun firmly guarded and would not surrender; Daoji broke him, bound Zun, and brought him to the army gate.

units.zh: 道濟怒殺之。
units.en: Tan Daoji killed him in fury.
units.literal: Daoji in anger killed him.

units.zh: 時洸司馬姚禹潛通於道濟，主簿閻恢、楊虔等皆禹之党，嫉玄忠誠，咸共毀之，固勸洸出戰。
units.en: Yao Guang's Major Yao Yu was in secret communication with Tan Daoji; Chief Clerk Yan Hui, Yang Qian, and others were all Yu's faction, jealous of Zhao Xuan's loyalty; they slandered him together and firmly urged Guang to go out to battle.
units.literal: At that time Guang's Major Yao Yu secretly communicated with Daoji; chief clerk Yan Hui and Yang Qian and others were all Yu's faction, jealous of Xuan's loyalty, together slandered him, and firmly urged Guang to go out to battle.

units.zh: 會陽城及成皋、滎陽、武牢諸城悉降，道濟等長驅而至。
units.en: Meanwhile Yangcheng, Chenggao, Xingyang and Wulao all surrendered, and Tan Daoji and the others advanced swiftly without a check.
units.literal: When Yangcheng and Chenggao, Xingyang, Wulao citadels all surrendered, Daoji and others drove straight through.

units.zh: 道濟進至洛陽、洸懼，遂降。
units.en: Tan Daoji reached Luoyang; Yao Guang surrendered in panic.
units.literal: Daoji advanced to Luoyang; Guang feared and then surrendered.

units.zh: 始隨到彥之北伐，與虜遇，聳夫手斬托跋燾叔父英文特勒首，燾以馬百匹贖之。
units.en: He had first followed Dao Yanzhi north; in battle he personally beheaded Tuoba Tao's uncle Yingwen Tele, and Tao ransomed the head with a hundred horses.
units.literal: At first he followed Dao Yanzhi on the northern campaign; meeting the enemy, Songfu personally beheaded Tuoba Tao's uncle Yingwen Tele; Tao ransomed the head with a hundred horses.

units.zh: 後一年，沮渠蒙遜殺段業，自稱涼。
units.en: A year later Juqu Mengxun slew Duan Ye and claimed Liang.
units.literal: One year later Juqu Mengxun killed Duan Ye and styled himself Liang.

units.zh: 樹洛干死，弟阿犲自稱驃騎將軍。
units.en: When Shuluoqian died, his younger brother Achai styled himself General of the Valiant Cavalry.
units.literal: Shuluoqian died; his younger brother Achai styled himself General of the Valiant Cavalry.

units.zh: 詔曰：「吐谷渾阿犲介在遐表，慕義可嘉，宜有寵任。
units.en: An edict declared, "Achai of the Tuyuhun, though he stands far beyond our borders, has shown admirable devotion to our cause and deserves favor and office.
units.literal: An edict said: "Tuyuhun's Achai stands far beyond the borders yet his admiration of righteousness is praiseworthy—he should receive favor and appointment.

units.zh: 未至而阿犲死，弟慕璝立。
units.en: The envoys had not yet arrived when Achai died; his younger brother Mugui succeeded.
units.literal: Before the envoys arrived Achai died; his younger brother Mugui succeeded.

units.zh: [7]六年，表曰：「大宋應運，四海宅心，臣亡兄阿犲慕義天朝，款情素著。
units.en: [7] In the sixth year he submitted a memorial: "Great Song has received Heaven's mandate and holds the hearts of all within the four seas. My late brother Achai long admired the celestial court, and his sincere devotion was well known.
units.literal: [7] In the sixth year he submitted a memorial saying: "Great Song has received the Mandate; within the four seas all hearts dwell here. My deceased elder brother Achai admired righteousness toward the celestial court; his sincere regard was always evident.

units.zh: 弟慕延為平東將軍，慕璝兄樹洛干子拾寅為平北將軍，阿豺子煒代鎮軍將軍。
units.en: His younger brother Muyan was made General Who Pacifies the East; Shiyin, son of Mugui's elder brother Shuluoqian, was made General Who Pacifies the North; and Wei, son of Achai, was made Acting General of the Garrison Army.
units.literal: His younger brother Muyan was made General Who Pacifies the East; Mugui's elder brother Shuluoqian's son Shiyin was made General Who Pacifies the North; Achai's son Wei was made Acting General of the Garrison Army.

units.zh: 十九年，追贈阿豺本號安西、秦沙三州諸軍事、沙州刺史、領護羌校尉、隴西王。
units.en: In the nineteenth year Achai was posthumously granted his former titles—General Who Pacifies the West, Commander of Military Affairs in the three provinces of Qin and Sha, Governor of Shazhou, Colonel Protecting the Qiang, and King of Longxi.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year Achai was posthumously granted his former titles: Commander of Military Affairs in the three provinces of Qin and Sha, Governor of Shazhou, Colonel Protecting the Qiang, and King of Longxi.

units.zh: 今酬其來款，可督塞表諸軍事、安西將軍、沙州刺史、澆河公。」
units.en: In return for his embassy, let him be made Supervisor of Military Affairs beyond the Passes, General Who Pacifies the West, Governor of Shazhou, and Duke of Jiaohe."
units.literal: Now in recompense for his coming with sincere regard, he may be Supervisor of Military Affairs beyond the Passes, General Who Pacifies the West, Governor of Shazhou, and Duke of Jiaohe."

units.zh: 譙縱亂蜀，阿犲遣其從子西彊公吐谷渾敕來泥拓土至龍涸、平康。
units.en: When Qiao Zong threw Shu into chaos, Achai sent his cousin, the Western Qiang Duke Tuyuhun Chilai Ni, to expand their territory as far as Longgu and Pingkang.
units.literal: When Qiao Zong threw Shu into disorder, Achai sent his cousin the Western Qiang Duke Tuyuhun Chilai Ni to expand territory as far as Longgu and Pingkang.

units.zh: 少帝景平中，阿犲遣使上表獻方物。
units.en: During the Jingping era of Emperor Shao, Achai sent envoys with a memorial offering local tribute.
units.literal: In the Jingping era of Emperor Shao, Achai sent envoys with a memorial presenting local products.

units.zh: 未及拜受，太祖元嘉三年，又詔加除命。
units.en: Before he could receive and accept these offices, in the third year of Emperor Taizu's Yuanjia reign a further edict added new appointments.
units.literal: Before he could receive investiture and accept office, in the third year of the Yuanjia era of Emperor Taizu there was again an edict adding further appointments.

units.zh: 以豫州刺史彭城王義康為南豫州刺史，征虜將軍劉粹為豫州刺史。
units.en: The Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, was made Governor of South Yu Province; General Who Punishes Barbarians Liu Cui was made Governor of Yu Province.
units.literal: The Prince of Pengcheng, Yikang, was made Governor of South Yu Province; General Who Punishes Barbarians Liu Cui was made Governor of Yu Province.

units.zh: 臧燾，字德仁，東莞莒人，武敬皇后兄也。
units.en: Zang Dao, whose courtesy name was De Ren, came from Ju in Dongguan and was the elder brother of Empress Wu Jing.
units.literal: Zang Dao, styled De Ren, was a man of Ju in Dongguan and elder brother to Empress Wu Jing.

units.zh: 高祖受命，征拜太常，雖外戚貴顯，而彌自沖約，茅屋蔬餐，不改其舊。
units.en: When the Founding Emperor received the mandate, Dao was summoned as Minister of Ceremonies; though he was now a prominent imperial kinsman, he became only more restrained, keeping to his thatched dwelling and plain meals as before.
units.literal: When the Founding Emperor received the mandate he was summoned and appointed Minister of Ceremonies; though a prominent maternal relative, he became only more self-restrained and modest, living in thatched huts on vegetable fare without changing his former ways.

units.zh: 永興三年按永興乃拓跋嗣年號
units.en: "In the third year of Yongxing"—Commentary: Yongxing was an era name of Tuoba Si (Emperor Mingyuan)
units.literal: Third year of Yongxing—Commentary: Yongxing is the era name of Tuoba Si

units.zh: 〈四０九－四一三〉，
太子太保張行簡請用漢昌邑王、晉海西公故事，侍郎史完顏訛出等十人請降復王封。
units.en: Grand Preceptor Zhang Xingjian cited the precedents of the Han Prince of Changyi and the Jin Prince of Haixi; Vice Director Wanyan Echu and ten others asked for demotion with restoration of princely rank.
units.literal: Grand Preceptor Zhang Xingjian asked to follow the precedents of the Han Prince of Changyi and the Jin Prince of Haixi; Vice Director Wanyan Echu and ten others asked for demotion with restoration of princely enfeoffment.
